buddy.intro: You searched for free Robux. Look at all these results!

buddy.choices: You can tap the top result, close Safari, or tell an adult. What would you do?

do.text: Oh no! Let's see what happened.

ignore.text: You're safe, but the scammer is still out there.

tell.text: Awesome! A grown-up helped stop the scam!

stop.text: 'Limited time' was trying to make you rush.

check.text: 'Sponsored' means someone paid to put this at the top. Scammers can buy ads too.
The real Roblox website is roblox.com. This one is roblox-giveaway-official.net, a different website.
Free stuff that sounds too good to be true usually isn't real.
Look! Roblox's own help page says free Robux sites are scams.
This is where the link goes. It looks real, but anyone can copy a logo. Looking real doesn't make it real.
It wants your password, and the address bar doesn't say roblox.com. Close it!

recap.tell: Show a grown-up and say: 'I found a website that gives free Robux. Is it real?'

tip.label: Get Robux safely
buddy: Want Robux? Only get it in the real Roblox app or on roblox.com, with a grown-up.
Roblox will never ask for your password on another website.

summary.solution: Only get Robux in the real Roblox app or on roblox.com, with a grown-up.
